description: VPIC-Kokkos (TauferLab/vpic-kokkos devel): CMake args that build a fast Cray/OpenMP build, the traced/untraced flux run command (TLS tunable, --tpp), a sized I/O-enabled short_pulse deck copy, and a build check.
instructions: Call workload_vpic_kokkos's own tools (vpic_cmake_args, vpic_run_command, vpic_deck_prepare, workload_vpic_kokkos_recipe to predict; vpic_build_check, workload_vpic_kokkos_check to validate) to do its deterministic work and follow the Corrector section on any failed check; ask the user before any irreversible step (apply/cancel/confirm=true calls).
